description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Thran Dynamo that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Thran Dynamo token.
Activate the Thran Dynamo token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3 using the other Thran Dynamo token.
Repeat from step 2.
